13.2.1 NvM Service Dependencies
This chapter describes the usage of the specific meta-classes derived from ServiceNeeds within a Basic Software Module. The meta-class NvBlockNeeds is used to define requirements to configure the NVRAM Manager Service. There are several use cases how a Basic Software Module can interact with the NVRAM Manager service. Each use case is discussed in a separate sub-chapter.

In addition, they provide information for timing or call-chain analysis. These elements are neither relevant for the ICS nor otherwise needed for the conformance test, since the conformance test does not need this information to call single C-functions.
